github.title: How to Create a GitHub Personal Access Token
github.step1: Go to GitHub Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens
github.step2: Click "Generate new token" and select "Generate new token (classic)"
github.step4: Set an Expiration date or select "No expiration" (not recommended for security)
github.step6: Click "Generate token" at the bottom of the page
github.step7: Important: Copy the token immediately - it won't be shown again!
github.step8: Paste the token into the OAuth Token field in Timeasy
github.permission1: repo - Full control of private repositories (to access issues and create comments)

gitlab.title: How to Create a GitLab Personal Access Token
gitlab.step1: Go to your GitLab instance (e.g., gitlab.com) and sign in
gitlab.step3: In the left sidebar, click Access Tokens
gitlab.step5: Set an Expiration date or leave blank for no expiration
gitlab.step8: Important: Copy the token immediately - it won't be shown again!
gitlab.permission1: api - Complete read/write access to the API

jira.title: How to Create a Jira API Token
jira.step1: Go to Atlassian Account Management
jira.step2: Sign in with your Atlassian account
jira.step4: Enter a Label for your token (e.g., "Timeasy Integration")
jira.step6: Important: Copy the token immediately - it won't be shown again!
jira.step7: In Timeasy, use your email address as the Account Name and paste the token in the OAuth Token field
jira.permission1: Jira API access - The token provides access to Jira projects and issues you have permission to view
jira.permission2: Project access - You must have at least "Browse Projects" permission in the Jira projects you want to integrate
